integrity: All formulas concern ordinary degrees in positive-conductance weighted spanning-tree measures, not minimum spanning trees. The block-cofactor proof is analytic, with finite exact checks as supplementary evidence. Historical priority requires independent evaluation.
limitations: Only one-vertex degree marginals, degree convex-order comparisons for shared matching conductance, and expected leaf counts are established. No assertion is made for arbitrary independent edge weights, joint degrees, or rates of asymptotic convergence.
title: A convex-order optimum and Poisson–Bernoulli crossover for matching-weighted bipartite spanning trees
